ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark gray/black) across approximately 85-90% of the surface area, with localized high-intensity (white/light gray) clusters occupying the remaining 10-15% primarily at the distal tips and scar sites.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous low-intensity regions cover the central and medial fluke. High-intensity mottling is clustered at the far left and far right distal tips. Distinctive white circular rings (rosettes) are distributed sporadically across the mid-lobes, and two parallel high-intensity vertical lines are mapped to the lower-central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a visible interior angle and significant pixel-depth relative to the fluke horizontal span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration profile; high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks and valleys along the majority of the trailing edge, with more pronounced jaggedness on the outer third of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature from the median notch extending outward, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular and ring-shaped pixel clusters (0-marks) scattered across both lobes, with higher density on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, high-contrast vertical parallel linear pixel disruptions located in the lower-central region of the fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across both lobes and prominent parallel vertical rake-like abrasions in the lower central fluke section.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of the deep median notch and the specific parallel vertical scarring at the fluke base.
